title: Optimization of tapered flow channels with variable cross-sections for proton exchange membrane fuel cells based on improved genetic algorithm
status: Provisional OpenFOAM reconstruction; quantitative agreement and paper optimization are not established.

paper_model.description: Steady 3D laminar nonisothermal two-phase single-channel PEMFC; ideal gas; isotropic GDL/CL; no gravity; fully wetted impermeable membrane stated.
paper_model.equations: Mass, laminar momentum/Darcy resistance, species, electronic/protonic potentials with Butler-Volmer reaction, heat. Printed liquid-water transport closures are absent.

geometry.pitch_and_area_provenance: Inferred full channel-plus-rib repeat width 2 mm, fixed across designs; source gives width and rib but not an explicit activation area.
geometry.profile: Linear width and linear height between inlet and outlet; endpoint products fixed. Interior cross-sectional area is not constrained to 1 mm2.
geometry.mesh_representation: Orthogonal voxel approximation of tapered side/top walls. Exact endpoint dimensions are retained unless knots are closer than 0.001 mm; regularization is recorded and mesh port errors above 0.5 percent are rejected. Geometric sensitivity remains necessary.

optimization.pumping_scope: Cathode only; no compressor efficiency factor reported. This is a pumping-to-gross-power ratio, not negative net power.
optimization.implementation_scope: Register CFD problem with existing framework optimizers; do not claim reproduction of published GA/IGA implementation or optima.

reported_boundary_conditions.inlets: Stoichiometric velocities from reference maximum current im, whose value is not supplied.
reported_boundary_conditions.outlets: Operating pressure 1 atm; detailed outlet and terminal boundary setup not supplied.

explicit_reconstruction_assumptions.reference_current_provenance: Unreported; declared estimate, not fitted to paper output. Fixed for all geometries.
explicit_reconstruction_assumptions.reactant_kinetics: Use local gas concentration ct*yr relative to reported 40.88 mol/m3. Separate (1-s)^1.5 available-reaction factor is a supplementary closure.
explicit_reconstruction_assumptions.membrane: Initialize fully hydrated lambda=14.003, then solve conservative water diffusion, electro-osmotic drag and sorption. This extends the paper fully-wetted statement; hydration is not held fixed.
explicit_reconstruction_assumptions.liquid: Supplementary capillary/Darcy transport in GDL/CL, carrier advection/dispersion in channel, and condensation/evaporation. Coefficients are assumptions, not author data.
explicit_reconstruction_assumptions.species: Conservative molar-mixture formulation with mixture-averaged diffusivities, rather than literal paper mass-fraction notation.
other_unreported_inputs: membrane transport and proton conductivity law
plate backing thickness/conductivity and exact terminal placement
solver tolerances and detailed mesh distributions
explicit_reconstruction_assumptions.thermal_reference_status: Thermoneutral1.48V uses liquid-product HHV; reaction reversible heat is split equally between CLs after subtracting MW*latent_heat/(2F), assigning vapor enthalpy to generated/dissolved water. Explicit condensation/evaporation then adds/subtracts latent heat without double-counting. Sorption enthalpy is neglected.

equation_corrections.issue: Printed water source is negative and uses MO2.
equation_corrections.implementation: Generate water using positive H2O stoichiometry and conserve Faraday/mass/charge sources.

equation_corrections.issue: Cathode electronic/protonic source signs both printed positive despite their required zero sum.
Both forward/reverse BV exponential signs are printed positive.
equation_corrections.implementation: Use opposing exponent signs with alpha*F/(R*T); alpha is unreported and explicitly estimated.

equation_corrections.issue: Cathode oxygen feed uses 2F rather than stoichiometric4F; w notation is ambiguous.
equation_corrections.implementation: Use4F per O2 and2F per H2 with declared mole fractions and fixed reference current.

reference_discrepancies: Table3 rounded widths/heights do not multiply to exactly1 mm2. Reference feasible designs retain printed widths and derive reciprocal heights.
Figure7f IGA power572.28 minus CFC480.84 equals91.44 mW/cm2, whereas text reports90.42.
Figure4a mesh test at0.4V is approximately1.099 A/cm2, whereas Figure7f CFC power at0.4V implies1.2021 A/cm2; unreported setup differences are possible.

The reported GA and IGA fitness values plus Figure7f powers/pressures imply inlet flow rates differing by about1.88%, despite stated consistent inlet conditions. These are reference inconsistencies, not solver calibration targets.
validation_policy: Numerical qualification, mesh independence, and agreement with paper/experiment must be recorded separately. No reference numbers substitute for CFD; no hidden parameter fitting.
